closeout.title: Lessons audit, reconcile, hygiene, acceptance
closeout.imperative: The run cannot close with unrouted observations. 1) Compile a run brief (epic intent, project-customized templates per the TEMPLATES_MANIFEST diff, model tiers used) and dispatch a fresh-context subagent invoking constellation-lessons-auditor over the artifacts (ADMIRAL_LOG, AGENT_FEEDBACK entries, crew Workflow Feedback, closeout tables); give every returned candidate a routed disposition. LESSONS.md is a transitory inbox, not a playbook: an audit ends every lesson it reads — graduate its operative content into the permanent doc that owns it (a template, a skill doctrine section, a reference, or a code-fix issue) and then retire the lesson, or delete it with a reason; nothing audited stays active. Dispositions: graduate-and-retire to a named home, template delta, Charter nomination, constellation export (.agent-work/CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.md, carrying the originating lesson id in the entry's Lesson field for stable cross-run recurrence identity), lesson-inbox delta for between-audit staging, or drop-with-reason. Apply every lesson-inbox delta — including each graduation's paired retire op — only via py C:/Users/fredc/.claude/skills/constellation-admiral/scripts/apply_lessons_delta.py with tick=true; never edit LESSONS.md directly. A lesson that graduates into project doctrine (.md / .template.*) needs authority=human on its apply op — reshaping doctrine is a human call. On an autonomous run with no reachable human, do NOT self-apply doctrine: surface it for the human's acceptance (they may say apply, or wait and re-observe) and defer with 'needs human' until then. Code-target graduations (test suite as proof) stay autonomous. Every banked lesson (add) carries a bank_reason — the reason it is worth re-observing rather than fixing now. When a graduation edits a shipped compact-format JSON template, edit the raw text surgically (never round-trip it through json.load/json.dump, which reflows the file and destroys blame) and re-validate with json.load afterward. 2) Append the epic retrospective to .agent-work/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md. 3) Hand the epic's net change to a constellation-cartographer subagent for architecture reconcile. 4) Hygiene: every branch merged or dispositioned, worktrees swept, ADMIRAL_LOG archived under .agent-work/archive/. 5) Present the epic summary and get user acceptance. Then release the lease: <engine> release --session-id admiral-epic-418.
